item.title: Sherry Cornecki

item.title: Kenneth Boddorf
item.description: Kenneth D. Boddorf, 96, of New Bethlehem, passed away peacefully Friday, November 28, 2025, at Clarion Hospital. Born in Brookville on June 22, 1929, he was the son of the late Irvin and Hazel McDevitt Boddorf. Ken quit school at the age of 15 and at 19 he enlisted.
